kind: declarative recipe; worker writes the test helper, triage did not execute a generator

report.replacement: zero-based section ordinal, exactly six ASCII decimal digits
report.algorithm: For target T, let P and S be prefix/suffix UTF-8 byte counts, U be template byte count (all replacements preserve its size). Let B=T-P-S-2, N=B integer-divided by U, R=B modulo U. Emit prefix, N numbered copies of template, two LF bytes, R copies of ASCII x, suffix. Never truncate a template or a UTF-8 sequence. Assert 0<=N<1000000 and exact emitted byte count T. R is less than one template, not a giant leaf. The first numbered section is 000000. No image fetch is part of this primary benchmark.

unbroken.algorithm: Emit prefix, exactly T-prefixBytes-suffixBytes copies of ASCII x as one paragraph, suffix. No inserted line break or whitespace inside that paragraph. Assert exact byte count T.

code.algorithm: Let B=T-prefixBytes-suffixBytes. Emit prefix, B integer-divided by lineBytes full copies of line, B modulo lineBytes spaces, suffix. Assert exact byte count T. Parser code literal is the emitted body including the first LF of suffix. Both generated bodies exceed the existing 262144-scalar highlighting budget and must stay fully literal, without token attributes. Do not run or compile fixture code.

supplementalCases: offline-control.md and reachable-footnotes.md are committed small semantic controls
For code scalar boundaries, use the existing highlighter constant and generate payloads at limit-1, limit, limit+1 in the worker's new pure tests; do not change the constant
No-reference variant: append unused/disconnected footnote definitions to a small report copy; their bodies stay absent
Missing remote assets are represented by inert https://assets.invalid/not-present.png markup and an injected pending/failing loader; no actual network call or server is needed
outputPolicy: Generate in memory for pure units. Future user-owned native validation may write copies to an external temporary fixture directory with the local asset alongside them. Never commit generated megabyte files. Record generated SHA-256 and exact bytes from the worker's helper; no generated-output hashes were measured by triage.
